import numpy as np
import random

# Generate the Erdős–Rényi graph G(200, 0.3) with seed=17
np.random.seed(17)
random.seed(17)

n = 200
p = 0.3

# Generate adjacency matrix
adj_matrix = np.zeros((n, n), dtype=int)
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1, n):
        if np.random.random() < p:
            adj_matrix[i][j] = 1
            adj_matrix[j][i] = 1

# Convert to edge list for easier processing
edges = []
for i in range(n):
    for j in range(i+1, n):
        if adj_matrix[i][j] == 1:
            edges.append((i, j))

# Initialize with a random partition
partition = [random.randint(0, 1) for _ in range(n)]

# Local search to improve the partition
def count_cut_edges(partition, edges):
    count = 0
    for i, j in edges:
        if partition[i] != partition[j]:
            count += 1
    return count

# Greedy improvement
max_iterations = 1000
current_cut = count_cut_edges(partition, edges)

for iteration in range(max_iterations):
    improved = False
    for vertex in range(n):
        # Try flipping this vertex
        old_label = partition[vertex]
        partition[vertex] = 1 - old_label
        new_cut = count_cut_edges(partition, edges)
        
        if new_cut > current_cut:
            current_cut = new_cut
            improved = True
        else:
            # Revert the change
            partition[vertex] = old_label
    
    if not improved:
        break

# Try multiple random restarts to find better solutions
best_partition = partition[:]
best_cut = current_cut

for restart in range(20):
    # Random restart
    partition = [random.randint(0, 1) for _ in range(n)]
    current_cut = count_cut_edges(partition, edges)
    
    # Local search
    for iteration in range(500):
        improved = False
        for vertex in range(n):
            old_label = partition[vertex]
            partition[vertex] = 1 - old_label
            new_cut = count_cut_edges(partition, edges)
            
            if new_cut > current_cut:
                current_cut = new_cut
                improved = True
            else:
                partition[vertex] = old_label
        
        if not improved:
            break
    
    if current_cut > best_cut:
        best_cut = current_cut
        best_partition = partition[:]
